strings.name: Zinedine Zidane
strings.summary: Zidane developed in Marseille and Cannes, becoming France’s creative center through control, vision and passing. He won the 1998 World Cup and Euro 2000 and played for Juventus and Real Madrid. Sent off for headbutting an opponent in the 2006 World Cup final, he then ended his playing career. He coached Madrid to three consecutive Champions Leagues and became France coach in 2026.
